A '''cam operator''' worked for the [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Javis Tyrr]] in the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. In [[44 ABY]], [[Wynn Dorvan]] organized the arrest of Tyrr for illegal espionage with the help of the [[Holocamera/Legends|cam]] operator.
